reading:
Rowan Green Data LLC, doing business as Rowan Digital Infrastructure, began in 2020 as a joint venture between Quinbrook Infrastructure Partners and Birch Infrastructure, created to deliver low-cost, renewables-powered land solutions to data center operators. It is now a wholly owned portfolio company of Quinbrook Infrastructure Partners, headquartered in San Francisco, California.

Quinbrook's own press release describes Rowan's flagship project as an 800 megawatt multi-tenant campus in Temple, Texas, with a 220 megawatt first phase nearing construction completion as of a January 2023 announcement, and states the platform has expanded to more than 20 strategically positioned host sites across the United States. That release did not mention Oregon operations directly. Separately, trade press from Data Center Dynamics reports Rowan planning a 1 million square foot data center campus in Morrow County, Oregon, and a Boardman, Oregon area chamber of commerce business listing confirms Rowan Green Data LLC, DBA Rowan Digital Infrastructure, as a registered member there.

The registry here tracks 4 Rowan facilities, all in Oregon, in the same Morrow County, Columbia River hydropower corridor already carrying Meta, Google, and Amazon buildout recorded elsewhere in this registry. Given Rowan's stated business model of providing power and land solutions to other data center operators rather than always operating end-user compute itself, this registry's facility-level research phase should check whether these Oregon sites are Rowan-operated facilities or Rowan-developed land later operated by a tenant.
